getTodayLocalDate() : new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]; const today = new Date(todayStr); if (type === 'start-today') { if (elStart) elStart.value = todayStr; } else if (type === 'end-today') { if (elEnd) elEnd.value = todayStr; } else if (type === '7-days') { if (elStart && !elStart.value) elStart.value = todayStr; const end = new Date(today.getTime() + 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); if (elEnd) elEnd.value = end.toISOString().split('T')[0]; } else if (type === '30-days') { if (elStart && !elStart.value) elStart.value = todayStr; const end = new Date(today.getTime() + 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000); if (elEnd) elEnd.value = end.toISOString().split('T')[0]; } if (typeof calculateCountDays === 'function') calculateCountDays(); if (typeof syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview === 'function') syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview(); }; window.quickInsertTakeawayPrompt = function(promptText) { const ta = document.getElementById('editBookTakeaway'); if (!ta) return; if (ta.value.trim() === '') { ta.value = promptText; } else { ta.value += '\n' + promptText; } ta.focus(); if (typeof updateTakeawayCounter === 'function') updateTakeawayCounter(); }; window.updateTakeawayCounter = function() { const ta = document.getElementById('editBookTakeaway'); const counter = document.getElementById('editTakeawayCounter'); if (!ta || !counter) return; const text = ta.value.trim(); const words = text ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0; const chars = ta.value.length; counter.innerText = words + ' words • ' + chars + ' chars'; }; window.setEditBookStatusSegment = function(st) { const sel = document.getElementById('editBookStatus'); if (sel) sel.value = st; if (typeof onEditBookStatusChange === 'function') onEditBookStatusChange(st); }; window.onPagesSliderInput = function(pctVal) { const pct = parseInt(pctVal, 10) || 0; const totP = Math.max(1, parseInt(document.getElementById('editTotalPages')?.value, 10) || 250); const curPage = Math.min(totP, Math.round((pct / 100) * totP)); const elCur = document.getElementById('editCurrentPage'); if (elCur) elCur.value = curPage; if (typeof syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview === 'function') syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview(); }; window.switchEditStudioTab = function(tabName) { try { var tabs = ['info', 'reading', 'store', 'timeline']; tabs.forEach(function(t) { var pane = document.getElementById('editTabPane_' + t); var btn = document.getElementById('editTabBtn_' + t); if (pane) { pane.style.setProperty('display', (t === tabName) ? 'block' : 'none', 'important'); } if (btn) { if (t === tabName) { btn.className = 'edit-studio-tab-pill active'; btn.style.setProperty('background', 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #d97706 100%)', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('color', '#0b0f19', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('border-color', '#fbbf24', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('font-weight', '900', 'important'); } else { btn.className = 'edit-studio-tab-pill'; btn.style.setProperty('background', 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('color', '#cbd5e1', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('border-color', 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)', 'important'); btn.style.setProperty('font-weight', '700', 'important'); } } }); var body = document.querySelector('.luxury-studio-body') || document.querySelector('.studio-body'); if (body) body.scrollTop = 0; if (typeof syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview === 'function') { syncEditModalLiveHeroPreview(); } } catch (err) { console.error('switchEditStudioTab error:', err); } };
